name: @mcsherrylabs/pi-evolver
description: Pi agent extension: chain-generic tools over an Evolver node — read the chain, sign a transfer, administer what you own, write to a channel, submit a signed transaction. Wraps @mcsherrylabs/evolver-client; implements no wire format of its own.
